items.summary: TheRock ROCm 10.1 SDK clang (AMD clang 24.0.0git d6f6cb69), gfx942 and gfx90a: MachineLICM-related miscompile in gpu4pyscf gvhf-rys rys_jk_kernel. A VGPR materialised once as 0 (v20, the vaddr offset of the work-queue global_atomic_add on head) is reused as the destination of a predicated global_load_dwordx2 inside the loop, so the next loop iteration's atomic faults (HSA MEMORY_APERTURE_VIOLATION) for any basis with d shells. -O1 still faults; -mllvm -disable-machine-licm (compile and link flags, -fgpu-rdc) fixes it. Reproducer: standalone device-only compile of gvhf-rys/rys_contract_jk.cu at fork 45d8053 and check the atomic's vaddr register for other defs. Choice for a person: file upstream ROCm/llvm-project, and whether the port should carry the flag.

rocBLAS strsm/dtrsm (TheRock ROCm 10.1, rocBLAS 5.7.0, gfx942) on gpu4pyscf's density-fitting Cholesky factors: on the DF-MP2 fp32 case (n=136, cond(L)=864, 270 structured right-hand sides) backward error 22 eps vs 3.8 eps for LAPACK, forward error 2.2e-5 vs 2.8e-6; on random right-hand sides with the same factor it matches LAPACK. Within the normwise n*eps bound, so an accuracy-margin report rather than a correctness bug. It makes test_dfmp2_kernel_one_gpu, test_grad_hybrid and test_j_energy_per_atom miss their tolerances by <3x (swapping in scipy's solve fixes each). Choice for a person: report to rocBLAS, or accept.

Before the upstream PR, correct the failure classification in the dc45713 commit body (repeated in notes 'Porter 2026-10-31' part 2) during the PR-prep squash. Of its '4 miss tolerances' list, the DF-MP2, DF-RKS hybrid gradient and multi-DM J energy cases come from rocBLAS trsm accuracy, not 'float32 DF-MP2' or 'atomic accumulation order'. Evidence: notes Review 2026-10-31.

TheRock ROCm SDK 10.1.0 rocBLAS (librocblas.so.5.7) on gfx1100 (Radeon Pro W7800): rocblas_gemm_strided_batched_ex with f64, transA=transB=N, M=N=1, batch_count > 65536 returns wrong values for a varying handful of batch entries on many calls (k=64: 0 wrong at batch 65536, 4167 at 131072, 16589 at 262144 over 10 calls; k=16 and k=5 also, k=5 sporadically). rocblas_ddot_strided_batched on the same data is exact, and 4x4/8x8 or M/N=2 shapes and f32 are clean. In gpu4pyscf it reaches users through cupy.einsum batched contractions (no cuTENSOR on ROCm), e.g. dft/mcfun_gpu.py _eval_xc_lebedev, and fails dft/tests/test_numint2c.py::test_eval_xc_eff_fp (MGGA_C_M06 multicollinear vmat off by up to 4e-7, run to run). Port workaround (a person rules): avoid the m=n=1 batched GEMM, e.g. (a*b).sum(0). Reproducer in notes.md Validation 2026-10-31 (linux-gfx1100).
